brand.question: What is BrandMyProfile?
brand.answer: BrandMyProfile (brandmyprofile.com) is an online CV writing and career-support service for professionals targeting jobs in Kuwait, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and India. A person rewrites your CV so it is clear and ATS-friendly, and BrandMyProfile also offers LinkedIn profile makeovers, career masterclasses and one-to-one career guidance. Everything is delivered online through WhatsApp, phone and email; there is no walk-in office.
